compiled_state.title: As a sprint orchestrator, I want a visual-evaluator agent emitting schema-conforming JSON with DOM-cross-checked findings, so pixel-observable UI issues become structured machine-routable signals
compiled_state.author: Test

comments.body:
## Description

**What**: Implement the visual-evaluator agent prompt file at plugins/dso/agents/visual-evaluator.md, including the full output schema, rubric with 25 per-integer anchor descriptors, attribution decision tree, and labeled few-shot examples.

**Why**: This is the core cognitive artifact of the VLM evaluator — without a properly specified agent prompt, all downstream skill, calibration, and integration stories have nothing to invoke.

**Scope**:
- IN: plugins/dso/agents/visual-evaluator.md with full schema, rubric, decision tree, few-shots
- IN: plugins/dso/schemas/visual-evaluator-schema.json (single source of truth for all downstream)
- IN: plugins/dso/config/visual-evaluator-params.yaml (imports from spike config artifact)
- IN: Two regression tests: schema-validation + DOM-cross-check
- OUT: Playwright screenshot capture (draft-2), calibration corpus (draft-3a)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, plugins/dso/agents/visual-evaluator.md exists emitting JSON conforming to the schema at plugins/dso/schemas/visual-evaluator-schema.json with all SC-1 fields including bbox_confidence (anchored|inferred), dom_xpath_visually_consistent, attribution_class, attribution_confidence, and scores for all 5 dimensions
  <- Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, the agent prompt includes per-integer anchor text for all 5 dimensions (5x5=25 anchors total) and the attribution decision tree (implementation_drift/design_flaw/mixed/uncertain routing logic)
  <- Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, the agent file contains ≥3 few-shot examples per attribution_class (≥12 total) in a reviewable table including both mobile and desktop contrastive pairs
  <- Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, a schema-validation regression test asserts JSON field presence and type constraints on a fixture PNG
  <- Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, a DOM-cross-check regression test asserts that dom_xpath_visually_consistent correctly reflects bbox-to-DOM agreement on a fixture with a known mismatch
  <- Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, plugins/dso/config/visual-evaluator-params.yaml records the model id, temperature, thinking_budget, max_tokens, and image_resolution from the spike artifact; the agent imports this file rather than re-hardcoding parameters
  <- Satisfies: sc-1
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] Schema-validation and DOM-cross-check are orthogonal failure modes — two separate test fixtures required
- [Design] Few-shot examples must include contrastive pairs across attribution classes to prevent class imbalance

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue. Escalate only when genuinely blocked. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
